# Example datasets

- Fictional documents with labelled structural errors, prepared for checker validation rather than generated by AI models.
- Small source files make each expected result easy to inspect.
- [`manifest.json`](manifest.json) lists the input pairs, planted issue codes and item IDs.

## Scoring

- Match each expected issue and item ID against the actual checker findings, including duplicate counts.
- Report missed issues and unexpected warnings separately.
- Use documents with no expected errors as controls.
- Assess structural checks only; quotation relevance, paraphrased findings and meaningful test coverage require human review.
